categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of peptide raw materials and formulations. The company also provides pharmaceutical research services for innovative peptide drugs, custom production services for peptide products, and technology transfer services related to peptide drug production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed advanced core technologies in peptide synthesis and modification, including long-chain peptide coupling, difficult sequence coupling, multi-peptide fragment coupling, single sulfur ring peptide scale-up production, multi-disulfide bond cyclic peptide synthesis, carbon ring peptide scale-up production, and side-chain modifications such as PEGylation and fatty acid modification. Production strictly follows GMP standards with integrated R&D and manufacturing capabilities, including CDMO services for peptide innovative drugs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international pharmaceutical companies and research institutions engaged in innovative peptide drug development. The company serves markets in major therapeutic areas such as diabetes, obesity, oncology, immune system diseases, chronic hepatitis B, reproductive health, and rare diseases. End markets include hospitals, medical institutions, and pharmaceutical manufacturers both in China and overseas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It has expanded its market presence internationally, with products registered and sold in the United States, European Union, South Korea, Russia, Southeast Asia, and Mexico. The company actively develops overseas marketing channels and participates in global pharmaceutical markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on peptide raw material synthesis, formulation production, and providing CDMO services. It also engages in technology transfer and custom manufacturing, serving as a key partner for innovative drug developers and generic drug manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven product development, focusing on peptide innovative drugs while maintaining a core business in generic peptides. It invests heavily in R&D, with a focus on expanding its peptide drug pipeline in major disease areas and enhancing CDMO service capabilities. Strategic priorities include capacity expansion, quality system enhancement, international market development, and collaboration with academic institutions for technology innovation, particularly in the peptide and health sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of peptide raw materials and formulations, pharmaceutical research service fees for innovative drug development, custom production contracts, and technology transfer fees. The company employs direct sales, agency sales, and distributor models domestically and internationally. It also earns income from government subsidies and investment returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Shengnuo Biotech is one of the leading peptide drug R&D and manufacturing enterprises in China, recognized for its strong core technologies and comprehensive peptide drug pipeline. It competes with domestic and international pharmaceutical companies in the peptide drug and CDMO sectors. The company holds a competitive position due to its integrated R&D and production capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and strategic partnerships with well-known pharmaceutical firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 456 million, representing a 4.84% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 50 million, a decrease of 28.88% compared to the previous year, mainly due to increased external R&D collaborations. Total assets reached approximately RMB 1.65 billion, with steady growth in R&D investment accounting for 11.06% of revenue. The company maintains a solid financial base with ongoing capacity expansion and international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its advanced peptide synthesis and modification technologies, enabling high-quality, scalable production of complex peptide drugs. It offers a full industry chain platform from R&D to commercial manufacturing, providing integrated CDMO services tailored to innovative drug developers. Its products cover a broad range of therapeutic areas with proven clinical efficacy and regulatory approvals domestically and internationally. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer-centric services to maintain competitive advantages in the growing peptide pharmaceutical market.
